# HEM v0.7.4b7 — Clear AQI values and source information

- Shows each selected outdoor AQI source by its own name and retains its reported numeric value when the value is available but its scale has not been configured. Unknown scales stay neutral and carry a clear explanation; stale or unavailable readings still show as missing.
- Separates unavailable measurements from AQI values that cannot yet be interpreted. The outdoor information explains scale configuration instead of presenting those values as identical empty AQI rows or falsely claiming that data is missing.
- Preserves provider-qualified US AQI, European categories and explicitly configured custom scales. Values on different or unknown scales are not guessed, relabelled or combined into a fabricated outdoor index.
- Makes outdoor sensor selection explicit for new Home setup. Existing selections, including an empty selection, are preserved. The legacy setup also accepts no outdoor sensors and offers the supported Automatic provider scale, while retaining the existing safeguards for missing outdoor evidence.
- Keeps AQI optional and preserves existing ventilation and device-control decisions. Adds backend and browser regressions for mixed AQI sources, missing values, scale diagnostics and narrow-screen information bubbles.

Update through HACS with beta versions enabled, restart Home Assistant to load the integration, and reload the dashboard.
